ns2:section.sectionText: Slay Them With a Sentence In her memoir The Writing Life, Annie Dillard tells this anecdote: “Do you think I could be a writer?” asks the aspiring writer. “Well, that depends,” answers the established one. “Do you like sentences?” In this course, we will revel in sentences. Moving from the most basic forms to complex architectural constructions, we’ll examine structure and syntax, rhythm and music in sentences built by writers of both poetry and prose. And we’ll experiment with writing our own dazzling and deathless sentences. Writers of all genres welcome. Pre-requisites: a beginning CW class (CW 100, CW 104, or CW 106) or permission of the instructor
